description: This script identifies downstream git commits that are not upstream and are visible in the diff, including functions for executing git commands, classes for finding commits, and a main function for command-line execution.

classes.name: CommitFinder
classes.description: A class to find commits that are present in the diff between upstream and downstream branches for a specific file.

methods.name: git
methods.description: Executes a git command with provided arguments and returns its output.

methods.name: find_insertion_commits
methods.description: Finds all commits that insert lines on top of the upstream baseline for the given branches.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds downstream commits that are not upstream and are visible in the diff.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that parses arguments and outputs the set of commits missing upstream.
